reden: Yes. The audit’s [High] issue exactly matches H-03: it pinpoints SecondSwap_StepVesting.transferVesting() resetting releaseRate to totalAmount/numOfSteps, ignoring amountClaimed and stepsClaimed, which allows over-claim before the final step because claimable() multiplies releaseRate by claimableSteps without capping at remaining amount. It even provides the same correct formula ((totalAmount - amountClaimed) / (numOfSteps - stepsClaimed)) and the same impact (claiming more than total and stealing from the pool). Fixing the miscalculation as suggested would resolve both descriptions, confirming they are the same vulnerability in the same function and code path.
